Old-Fashioned Apple Crisp
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




4 cups Apple, tart, sliced, peeled
3/4 cup Brown sugar
1/2 cup Flour, all-purpose
1/2 cup Rolled oats
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon Allspice
 cup Butter or margarine, cold
Vanilla Ice Cream

Preparation

1 Place apples in a greased 8-in. square baking dish. In a bowl, combine brown sugar, flour, oats, cinnamon and allspice; cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until apples are tender. Serve warm with ice cream. 2 Yield: 4-6 servings.
